items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: And Bolden, the sticky cornered out the window, you know, and Hoopner, everybody go over there.

ctx.x: Really rough. Yeah. Robichaux had nice orchestras, you know, nice dance music. And Bolden, the sticky cornered out the window, you know, and Hoopner, everybody go over there. That's the way they used it. That was at Lincoln Park. It's one block north of the inbound track on Carlton Avenue.
Yeah, I know where that is. I went out and looked. There's nothing there now.
